meta.title: Configuration for Event: Technical Stage selection updates and saves successfully
gaps: Verify that the Technical Stage setting remains saved after reopening the draft.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the Technical Stage setting remains saved after reopening the draft.

steps.note: Open the events list to reach the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Drafts tab containing the saved eRFX draft.
Open the first saved draft and return to its draft create screen.
Open the RFQ configuration for the draft.
Confirm that the Configuration for Event window opened.
Select the Technical Stage option in the configuration window.
Confirm that the configuration window closed after saving.
Confirm the draft screen reflects the selected Technical Stage setting.
